title: briefing: the situation of one side at the start of a day, in ten parts and the objectives

enemy_ashore.description: What the side believes of the enemy's men ashore, from its ground reports (decision 0092, 19), and enemy bases a report found yesterday. Left out when the side holds no estimate and found no base.

away_at_yard.description: The forces away at the yard (decision 0069), each with the day it is back. Left out when none is away.

halts.description: Yesterday's halts at marked waypoints and the forces that steamed on (decision 0096, 7). Left out when there were none.

land_units.description: The side's land units and what yesterday's events say happened to their men (decision 0066, 21). Left out when the side has no land unit.

base_changes.description: Bases that changed side yesterday and what went with them (decision 0090, 29 and 30). Left out when no base changed side and nothing was lost with one.

objectives.description: The side's own mission and objectives (decision 0054), its progress as far as it can know it, and the umpire's result once the game is over. mission is null and objectives empty when the scenario has none; result is null until the game is over (and always null without objectives).

levels.description: From day 1: the margins (a side's points less the enemy's) that make a minor, a major and a decisive victory; the same margins against a side are defeats of the same level, and a margin of less than minor either way is a stalemate. null when the scenario has no objectives.

ship_points.description: For ships_sunk, ships_crippled and ships_out_of_action: the points for each kind of ship (for ships_out_of_action, for a ship away for the whole horizon). Empty for the others.

horizon_days.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out for every other kind): the days of the horizon its shares are of (decision 0088), at least 1.

points.description: Points for one aircraft, one ton or the base being as wanted; null for the ship objectives.

known.description: What the side knows of its progress, from its own units and the events it may see. basis is exact, claims (the enemy ships and aircraft the side's own claims say it sank, shot down or destroyed on the ground: they can be wrong, so count can be above the truth; points are for the kind of ship each claim names, or null where none does) or not_observable (count is 0 and says nothing).

days.description: For base_open at a base of the side's own: the days counted, which count is out of. Null for everything else.

result.description: The umpire's result for both sides, from the truth, told at the end of the game.

history.description: What happened in the real battle, not in this game: the scenario's note of how the day went in history, in words and not a computed score. It is not this game's result. null where the scenario gives none.

days.description: For base_open: the days counted, which count is out of. Null for the others.

horizon_days.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out for every other kind): the days of the horizon the shares are of, at least 1.

ships_out.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out when empty): each ship counted, in ship number order, with the days it was away and the points they earned.

ship.description: The side's own handle for a ship of its own (ship:7), with no name; for an enemy ship, which a side has no handle for, enemy_ship:3, her place in this list from 1.

at_end.description: Her days of repair still to run at the end of the game.

left_with.description: The days of repair she left for a yard with.

points.description: The kind's points times the share.

margin.description: This side's points less the other side's.

level.description: minor, major or decisive; null for a stalemate, which has no level (outcome says it in words).

outcome.description: The outcome in words: "minor victory", "major defeat", "stalemate" and so on.

last_day.description: The last day of the game: it ends when this day has been resolved. Null if the briefing was made without it.

rules_in_play.description: Which optional rules are in play; the text leaves out what a rule not in play would make meaningless.

reason.description: The engine's own words, with a short hint in brackets of what the order needs where the reason has one.

strike_report.description: What a strike reported back: an event that cites its attack or its finding nothing.

estimates.description: One estimate for each hex, in hex order.

bases_found_yesterday.description: Enemy bases a ground report put on the side's map yesterday (decision 0092, 15). Left out when none.

hits_on_men.description: Hits that landed on men ashore (decision 0092, 10). Left out when 0.

bombardments.description: Shore bombardments the side's own forces made last night (decision 0092, 17): the shells and the weighed shots, never a hit; what the side believes it did is in its claim. Left out when none.

shell_fire.description: What each of the side's own ships fired in those bombardments and the rounds it has left. Left out when none.

bombardments_against.description: Shore bombardments of the side's own bases last night (decision 0092, 18): the fire and where each hit landed, never the force or the ships that fired. The aircraft and supply destroyed are in losses and the bases, the men lost in land_units. Left out when none.

no_deck.description: Left out when 0. Aircraft that were in the air when their own deck was lost, found no other carrier with room and no base within reach, and came down in the sea.

ditched.description: Left out when 0. Aircraft that ran out of fuel on the way home from a strike or escort sortie beyond their radius, and are lost.

aircraft_landed_elsewhere.description: Left out when none. Aircraft that were in the air when their own deck was lost (the ship sank or her flight deck went out) and landed at another carrier or a base: from is the group they flew in, to the group that has them now (an existing one, or one formed by the landing), at the ship or base.

air_groups_rebased.description: Left out when none. Air groups moved to another base by a rebase order on the day just resolved (decision 0091). The group flew nothing that day. Its damaged aircraft, which could not fly, were written off at the base it left and are counted in aircraft as written_off.

ready.description: Ready aircraft that went with the group.

pilots.description: Pilots that went with the group; null where its pilots are not counted.

claims.description: Claims yesterday: what the side's own people believe they did in a fight at sea or a raid. They can be wrong. A claim from the air (from_air true) says hits on ships and the kind they were taken for, ships sunk, aircraft shot down and aircraft destroyed on the ground; a claim of a fight at sea says ships sunk only, with the rest 0 and null; the claim of a shore bombardment (from_bombardment true, from_air false) says aircraft believed destroyed on the ground and nothing else.

from_bombardment.description: True for the claim of a shore bombardment (decision 0092, 17). Left out when false.

event.description: The event that told the side; explain on it shows the side's own firing it rests on.

repaired_ship.description: A ship a base mended yesterday by forward repair (decision 0069): the points spent on her, what she has left of fire and flotation damage, the systems put back to working yesterday, and the systems she still has degraded or out.

halted.description: Forces that halted at a marked waypoint to act there.

at.description: The clock time it halted, such as D1 22:00.

waits_for.description: The reason it halted: bombard, cargo or both, in that order.

steamed_on.description: Halted forces that steamed on, each with the reasons.

reasons.description: Why it went: bombarded, cannot_bombard_any_longer (no ship could fire any longer) and cargo_work_done, those that apply.

taken.description: Bases the side took yesterday, with the stocks it kept and the stocks lost in the change.

lost.description: Bases the side lost yesterday. The stocks left in them are the new holder's and are not given.

air_groups_lost.description: The side's air groups lost with a base.

ships_lost.description: The side's ships lost in port with a base.

home_ports_lost.description: The side's task forces whose home port was lost.

strike_missions_cleared.description: The side's air groups whose base strike mission was cleared because the base is now the side's own.

from.description: The unit that kept its men ashore elsewhere.

land_unit.description: The new unit made of the men aboard.

base.description: The base loaded from; null off a bare shore.

cargo.description: supply or fuel; null for a load of men only.

base.description: The base asked; null where the side has none in the hex.

ship.description: The ship lost with, for lost_with_ship.

place.description: The hex of an unfed, fight or fire loss.

ashore.description: What the unit has left ashore there, for unfed, fight and fire.

fights_yesterday.description: Fights ashore the side's men were in yesterday (decision 0090, 28): the hex only, never which side attacked. Left out when none.

fire_yesterday.description: The side's own units' fire in yesterday's fights: firing men and shots, never the chance or the hits. Left out when none.

fatigue_yesterday.description: Changes of the side's own units' fatigue yesterday. Left out when none.

change.description: gained (on attack and fired), rested, marched or marched_and_attacked (decision 0094, 8), or landed (the unit's first men landed from a ship, decision 6 of 0095).

back_to_defend_yesterday.description: Units on attack too tired to go on that went back to defend yesterday; the posture order is spent. Left out when none.

fed_share_restored_yesterday.description: Units with no man ashore whose fed share went back to 1. Left out when none.

marches_yesterday.description: Marches the side's own units made a day of yesterday (decision 0094, 11). The men are still in from unless days is of_days. Left out when none.

march_arrivals_yesterday.description: Marches that ended yesterday: the unit's men arrived (decision 0094, 4 and 9), with the supply carried from the bases left and the base it went into (null when none was carried). Left out when none.

bases_formed_by_march_yesterday.description: Bases a march formed yesterday to hold the supply it carried (decision 0094, 9): the side's own, on its own map only. Left out when none.

marches_stopped_yesterday.description: Marches that stopped short yesterday (decision 0094, 3), with the days marched and why: ordered, no_men_ashore or no_land_link. Left out when none.

loading_yesterday.description: Loading gained or lost yesterday by the side's forces preparing a landing (decision 0095, 4, 5, 8 and 10). Left out when none.

loading_before.description: The loading before a loss. Left out for a gain.

reason.description: Why it fell: new_landing_place, unit_added, or spent (the landing is done and the order with it). Left out for a gain.

rehearsal_yesterday.description: Rehearsal gained or lost yesterday by the side's units (decision 0095, 3, 7 and 8). Left out when none.

task_force.description: The force whose roster the unit rehearsed for. Left out for a loss.

rehearsal.description: The rehearsal afterwards for a gain; the rehearsal before for a loss (a loss takes it to 0).

reason.description: Why it fell: new_landing_place, landed or other_landing_place. Left out for a gain.

roster_left_yesterday.description: Units that left a force's roster yesterday (decision 0095, 7 and 3c of 0099). Left out when none.

preparation_shared_yesterday.description: Forces that split yesterday and gave the new part their preparation (decision 12 of 0095). Left out when none.

units.description: The units of the roster the new part took.

experience_days_yesterday.description: Days of training and of firing counted yesterday toward a step of experience (decision 0097, 3 and 5). Left out when none.

days.description: The days counted toward the next step.

experience_raised_yesterday.description: Steps of experience gained yesterday (decisions 3 and 5 of 0097). Left out when none.

work_yesterday.description: Work made yesterday by the side's units (decision 0099), from its own UnitWorked events. Left out when none.

total.description: The work done on the airfield, the day's work on the port or on the aircraft, or the defences after the day.

airfields_built_yesterday.description: Airfields of the side built yesterday (decision 0099, 5). Left out when none.

supply_by_hex.description: For each hex with men of the side ashore: the side's lowest-numbered base there, the first that feeds them, and its other bases there (left out when none; the men are fed from every base of the side in the hex), the aircraft at those bases, their stock together, what the aircraft and the men cost a day, and the days the stock lasts at that charge (truncated to one decimal; null without a base or with no charge).

aboard.description: The unit's men in the ship afterwards.

ashore.description: The unit's men ashore in the hex afterwards.

airfield_yesterday.description: What yesterday's events of the side say of the base's airfield (decision 0103): hits that added damage, work that mended it, arrivals held back. Left out when there were none.

stocks_yesterday.description: Where the base's supply and fuel went and came from yesterday, by cause, from the side's own events. null when nothing moved in or out of either stock; otherwise supply and fuel are each null when that stock did not move. start_t is end_t less the net of the causes (landed less the others).

sorties_and_upkeep_t.description: Paid for sorties flown and aircraft kept at the base.

men_fed_t.description: Paid to feed men ashore (decision 0066, 16). Present only when something was paid for men.

taken_by_marches_t.description: Taken out by units that marched out of the base's hex (decision 0094, 9). Present only when something was taken.

arrived_with_marches_t.description: Put in by units that marched into the base's hex. Present only when something was put in.

refuelling_ships_t.description: Taken by ships to fill their own tanks.

task_force_propulsion.description: Task forces with a ship afloat whose propulsion is degraded or out. A force steams at the speed of its slowest ship, so a ship with propulsion out stops the whole force (effect cannot_move) and one degraded slows it (effect slowed).

strike_group_out_of_reach.description: An own air group on naval_strike that holds contacts but has none within its aircraft type's strike radius, or on base_strike at a base beyond it, at the time of the briefing: it would launch nothing. nearest is the nearest contact held (naval_strike) or the target base (base_strike); distance_nm is its air distance, the figure measure air_reach gives.

reach_nm.description: Given only for a group on extended reach: the reach in force in miles. The warning is made against it, not against radius_nm: a contact within it does not warn.

strike_group_holding.description: Left out when there is none. An own air group on naval_strike that holds contacts within its reach, none of a kind on its target list (set_target_priority): it holds its strike and launches nothing at them. nearest is the nearest contact within reach and nearest_taken_for the kind it is taken for; distance_nm is its air distance.

reach_nm.description: Given only for a group on extended reach: the reach in force in miles.
